newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa bonds, rand slightly weaker in late trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa bonds, rand slightly weaker in late trade.

text.p: 1408 GMT - Bonds end slightly weaker on the day after earlier attempt to move firmer met by longs cutting positions and strong U.S. GDP data which pushes U.S. long bond yield higher. Rand also slightly weaker following strong importer demand.

* Key R150 at 14.755 pct from 14.70 pct at 1400 GMT. Dealers say foreign buying on back of increase in Deutschebank euro issue met by institutional selling. Position squaring ahead of Thursdays's public holiday also leads to retracement from earlier lows.
* Market dented by U.S. long bond's rise to back above 7.00 percent after U.S. first quarter annualised GDP comes out up 5.6 percent vs forecast 4.1 percent.
* Dealers say trade on the day busy, and volatility expected to pick up Friday ahead of options close-out at noon.

* Rand last at 4.4450/4480 on dollar from 4.4415/4445 overnight. Trade on the day characterised by importer and month-end demand for dollars, which met by offshore selling. Trade on Friday expected to be extremely quiet as some players taking long-weekend with Thursday break. Range next week seen at 4.43 to 4.46.
